flags.why: Tiêu biểu cho means to exemplify or be representative of something, not to symbolise it.
flags.fix: to exemplify; to typify; to be representative of

flags.why: A dove symbolises peace, which calls for biểu tượng rather than tiêu biểu.
flags.fix: Tác phẩm này tiêu biểu cho phong cách của ông. = This work exemplifies his style.

flags.why: Learners are much more likely to encounter the adjective meaning eerie or spooky than the noun meaning evil spirits.
The waistband meaning is more commonly encountered in everyday Vietnamese than the biting or gnawing meaning.
